confirm_shared_impact.description: Confirm the selected queue cancellation and the provider-wide reconnection impact.

x_thread_retry_allowed.description: True only after an explicitly authorized X thread reset with no later attempt.

channel_name.description: Display name truncated to at most 100 Unicode characters in summaries.

provider.description: Provider label truncated to at most 64 Unicode characters in summaries.

observed_attempt_id.description: Required for Google owner reconciliation, Meta delivery checkpoints and X public-start checkpoints.

provider_inspected.description: For Google not-published recovery, inspection confirms the remote operation definitively failed, stopped, or was canceled. An absent post is not enough.

thread_ids.description: Complete ordered X post IDs for owner-attested thread completion.

thread_root_definitively_ended.description: Explicitly attest that the remote X thread root operation definitively ended without creating a post.

publication_ids.description: Complete list of queued publications with scheduling_mode=queue. Exact-date publications are excluded and remain fixed.

oneOf.description: Null means no linked replacement is currently visible; a request may still be running.

sender_stopped.description: Required and true for not_published: the owner attests the sender stopped.

RetireScheduleRequest.description: Retire exactly one saved scheduling intent without creating publications.

media_versions.description: Expected metadata versions for the exact effective media set. Omit only for legacy behavior.

request_id.description: Client-generated UUID retained for retries and recovery. Optional for legacy clients.

scheduled_at.description: Omit for a posting-rule slot; an exact RFC3339 time accepts at most six fractional digits.

version.description: The revision displayed and approved by the caller. Conflicts if the locked draft has changed.

media_versions.description: Original normalized media-version map, or null for legacy requests.

scheduled_at.description: UTC RFC3339, rendered to microsecond precision; null means a posting-rule slot.

next_index.description: Zero-based index of the first unconfirmed segment.

remaining_texts.description: Unconfirmed does not mean unsent; the first may already exist on X.

root_request_started.description: True only for an explicit current root-write checkpoint with zero confirmed IDs.

phase.description: `post_started` is the public delivery boundary, including text-only posts.
